{{Top|leg}}
A '''thermal shield generator''' formed a [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] shield around the wearer that, while ineffective against the common weaponry used during the [[Jedi Civil War]], did allow for the ablation of directed heat attacks, generally in the form of [[Fire/Legends|fire]].
